name: Lab Values Horizontal Badge ID Pocket Reference Card
seoTitle: Horizontal Lab Values Badge Card for Nurses
metaDescription: A horizontal lab values badge card that sits behind a nurse's ID, a small, budget friendly reference gift for nursing students, new grads, and floaters.
summary: A horizontal lab values card tucks behind a landscape ID badge, giving nursing students and new nurses a pocket reference for the shift.
whyItWorks: Not every hospital badge hangs the same way. If the nurse in your life wears a horizontal, landscape style ID, a matching reference card lines up neatly behind it instead of sticking out at odd angles. Lab values are one of those things nurses check constantly, especially early on, and having them at chest level saves time and a little stress.

It is a smart gift for students heading into med surg rotations, new grads in orientation, and float pool nurses who move between units and want a quick refresher. Experienced nurses may not need it, so it shines brightest for someone still building confidence. Because it is small and inexpensive, it is easy to add to a graduation card, a nursing school care package, or a stocking. Pair it with a matching card on another topic or a good badge reel and you have a thoughtful, useful bundle for a nurse just starting out.
goodToKnow: Confirm the recipient wears a horizontal badge; vertical badge wearers may prefer a different card.
Facility lab ranges can vary, so the card is a quick reference, not the final word.
Check the listing for which values are printed on the card.

faq.q: What does horizontal mean for a badge card?
faq.a: It is shaped for ID badges worn in landscape orientation, so the card lines up behind them. Ask or peek at their badge before buying.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for an experienced nurse?
faq.a: It is most helpful to students and newer nurses. A veteran nurse might still like it when floating or changing specialties.
